name: co2-ppm
title: CO₂ concentration at Mauna Loa (the Keeling Curve)
description: Atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration from NOAA GML — the Mauna Loa record (the longest continuous direct measurement of atmospheric CO₂, begun by C. David Keeling in March 1958 and maintained by NOAA and Scripps): monthly means from 1958 and annual means from 1959, in parts per million (ppm) of dry air. Also the NOAA global marine-boundary-layer annual mean (from 1979), and NOAA's published annual growth rates (ppm/yr, Jan 1 to Dec 31) for both Mauna Loa and the global network, with a derived decadal-mean-growth table.

resources.name: co2-monthly-mlo
resources.title: Monthly mean CO₂ at Mauna Loa

fields.name: date
fields.description: First day of the month the mean refers to (YYYY-MM-01). NOAA reports monthly values corrected to the centre of the month using the average seasonal cycle.

fields.name: decimal_date
fields.description: Mid-month date as a decimal year, as supplied by NOAA.

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO₂ mole fraction in parts per million (ppm) of dry air. Missing months are filled by NOAA with an interpolated value (flagged by an empty std_dev / uncertainty).

fields.name: co2_ppm_deseasonalized
fields.description: The monthly mean with the average seasonal cycle removed (NOAA's 'deseasonalized' column; previously labelled 'trend').

fields.name: num_days
fields.description: Number of daily means used to compute the monthly mean. Empty where NOAA has no information (all data before May 1974, sourced from Scripps, and interpolated months). NOAA's -1 sentinel is normalised to an empty cell.

fields.name: std_dev
fields.description: Standard deviation of the daily means within the month (ppm). Empty where unknown; NOAA's -9.99 sentinel is normalised to an empty cell.

fields.name: uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty of the monthly mean (ppm). Empty where unknown; NOAA's -0.99 sentinel is normalised to an empty cell.

resources.name: co2-annual-mlo
resources.title: Annual mean CO₂ at Mauna Loa

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year.

fields.name: co2_ppm_mean
fields.description: Annual mean CO₂ mole fraction in parts per million (ppm) of dry air, from the Mauna Loa record.

fields.name: uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty in the annual mean (ppm), taken as the standard deviation of annual means determined independently by NOAA/ESRL and Scripps.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year.

fields.name: co2_ppm_mean
fields.description: Globally averaged marine-boundary-layer annual mean CO₂ mole fraction (ppm of dry air), from the NOAA GML cooperative air sampling network. Available from 1979.

fields.name: uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty in the global annual mean (ppm), from a Monte Carlo resampling of the network (see NOAA documentation).

resources.name: co2-growth-annual
resources.title: Annual CO₂ growth rate (Mauna Loa and global)

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year.

fields.name: mlo_ppm_per_year
fields.description: CO₂ mole-fraction increase over the year (1 Jan to 31 Dec), ppm, from the Mauna Loa record. NOAA's published value, computed from monthly data — not a difference of annual means. Available from 1959.

fields.name: mlo_uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty in the Mauna Loa growth rate (ppm/yr).

fields.name: global_ppm_per_year
fields.description: CO₂ mole-fraction increase over the year (1 Jan to 31 Dec), ppm, from the global network. NOAA's published value. Pre-1980 values are approximated from Mauna Loa and the South Pole (see NOAA documentation).

fields.name: global_uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty in the global growth rate (ppm/yr).

resources.name: co2-growth-decadal
resources.title: Mean annual CO₂ growth rate by decade (derived)

fields.name: decade
fields.description: Decade label, e.g. '1960s' (years 1960–1969).

fields.name: mlo_mean_ppm_per_year
fields.description: Mean of the Mauna Loa annual growth rates in the decade (ppm/yr), derived from co2-growth-annual.

fields.name: global_mean_ppm_per_year
fields.description: Mean of the global annual growth rates in the decade (ppm/yr), derived from co2-growth-annual.

fields.name: n_years
fields.description: Number of years averaged. Less than 10 for the first and current (partial) decades.
